summary_en: Acquisition of additional shares in subsidiary toridori IS to achieve 100% ownership. Purchase price and payment terms not disclosed in first pages. Rationale: unified sales & marketing operations, compliance consolidation, synergyisation of customer base and sales platform, internalization of sales expertise.
title_en: Notice regarding Complete Subsidiary Acquisition of toridori IS Inc. and Execution of Secured Loan Agreement with Financial Covenants
translation_en_brief: On 27 July 2026, toridori Inc.'s board approved the acquisition of additional shares in toridori IS Inc., a consolidated subsidiary, to achieve 100% ownership. The filer also approved execution of a secured loan agreement with financial covenants to finance the acquisition. The filing does not disclose the purchase price, share count, or payment terms on the first two pages. Stated rationale: IS is a material sales and marketing function within the group supporting influencer platforms. Complete ownership will enable unified compliance management, consolidated agency networks, standardised sales training and distributor management, and full capture of synergies from cross-selling, upselling, and new product initiatives. Currently, IS is not wholly owned; non-controlling shareholders would receive a portion of synergy gains, constraining return on investment. Full ownership resolves this constraint and allows the group to deploy resources more decisively.
